items.name: exhaust gas sensor
items.definition: exhaust gas sensor：A sensor that gives an indication of a rich or lean exhaust and compares it to a reference.

items.name: angle of arrival
items.definition: angle of arrival：The angle at which a locus arrives at a complex zero in the s-plane.

items.name: 阻尼比
items.definition: 阻尼比：A measure of the damping of a system's dominant roots, often specified as a target value such as ζ=0.707.。

items.name: zeros of l s
items.definition: zeros of l s：The roots of b(s)=0, labeled z_i.

items.name: poles of l s
items.definition: poles of l s：The roots of a(s)=0, labeled p_i.
